title: General lab safety
description: Foundational safety: PPE, emergency exits, eyewash + shower locations, and what to do when things spill. Required before any other lab work.

quizData.question: Which combination is the minimum PPE for any wet-bench work?
options: Lab coat, safety glasses, closed-toe shoes
quizData.explanation: Lab coat + safety glasses + closed-toe shoes is the universal floor; gloves and respirators are added when the task warrants.

quizData.question: You spill 5 mL of dilute acid on the bench. What's the right first move?
options: Mop it up with a paper towel and toss it
Cover it with the appropriate spill kit absorbent, then clean and dispose per SOP
Wash it down the sink with lots of water
Leave it and tell the next user

quizData.question: Chemical splashes your eye. How long do you flush at the eyewash?
quizData.explanation: ANSI Z358.1: continuous flush for at least 15 minutes.

quizData.question: A solvent fire breaks out on the bench. Which extinguisher class do you reach for?
A near-miss happens — nobody hurt, no damage. What do you do?
options: File an incident report so the lab can fix the underlying cause
